meaning.en: the underlying reality is always truly true
meaning.hi: अंतर्निहित सत्य सदा वास्तव में सत्य है

meaning.en: speaking of it in terms of separate parts turns out to be false
meaning.hi: उसे अलग-अलग भागों में कहना मिथ्या सिद्ध होता है

words.sanskrit: tat cha karanam ekam hi na bhinnam na ubhayatmakam

meaning.en: that one cause is truly one, never split apart, never becoming two
meaning.hi: वह एक कारण सच में एक है, कभी विभाजित या दो नहीं होता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: everywhere, this sense of separateness is simply false
meaning.hi: सर्वत्र यह भेद-बोध बस मिथ्या है

meaning.en: because these apparent qualities cannot be shown to have their own existence
meaning.hi: क्योंकि गुणों का अपना स्वतंत्र अस्तित्व नहीं दिखाया जा सकता

words.sanskrit: atah cha karanam nityam ekam eva advayam khalu

meaning.en: this is why the cause is eternal, always one, truly without a second
meaning.hi: इसलिए कारण नित्य, सदा एक, और सच में अद्वितीय है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atra karanam advaitam shuddha chaitanyam eva hi

meaning.en: here, the cause is truly non-dual, pure consciousness itself
meaning.hi: यहाँ कारण सच में अद्वैत, शुद्ध चैतन्य ही है

words.sanskrit: asmin brahmapure veshma daharam yat idam mune

meaning.en: O sage, within this city of Brahman, this body, there is a small subtle space
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, इस ब्रह्मपुर में यह सूक्ष्म छोटा आकाश है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: pundarikam tu tanmadhye akasho daharah asti tat

meaning.en: in the middle of that space is a small lotus, and within it a subtle sky
meaning.hi: उस आकाश के मध्य में एक छोटा कमल है, उसके भीतर सूक्ष्म आकाश

meaning.en: that is Shiva, made of being, awareness, and bliss
meaning.hi: वही शिव है, सत्-चित्त-आनंद से बना

meaning.en: that is exactly what those seeking liberation must search for
meaning.hi: वही है जिसे मुमुक्षुओं को खोजना चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ayam hridi sthitah sakshi sarvesham avisheshatah

meaning.en: this dwells in the heart as the witness of everyone, without distinction
meaning.hi: यह हृदय में सबके साक्षी रूप में निवास करता है, बिना भेद

meaning.en: that is why it is called hridaya, the heart
meaning.hi: इसीलिए इसे हृदय कहा जाता है

meaning.en: Shiva is the one who sets a person free from the cycle of existence
meaning.hi: शिव संसार से मुक्त करने वाले हैं
